description: This Java source file defines a final class ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, which is a builder for creating responses and events related to modification commands on feature properties in a live command processing context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements a fluent API for constructing command responses such as creation, modification, and error responses, as well as event instances signifying property creations and modifications.
